title: Spreading a generic product embedding on the model ring
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $B$ a finite commutative $A$-algebra [pqf-lem-finite-integral-lft], $K$ a fraction field of $A$, and $K'$ a field extension of $K$ [def-pc-field-extension] with compatible $A$-algebra structure. Let $R_0$ be a Noetherian domain with compatible $A$-algebra structure and an $R_0$-algebra structure on $K'$ making $K'$ its fraction field. Let $r$ be a natural number, and $L_j$ fields over $K'$ for $j\in\operatorname{Fin}(r)$. Suppose the reduction of $(K\otimes_A B)\otimes_K K'$ is isomorphic as a $K'$-algebra to $\prod_jL_j$. Then there is $0\ne t\in R_0$ such that for every $s\in R_0$ divisible by $t$ and every commutative ring $R$ in the universe of $A$ which is $R_0[1/s]$, with compatible maps $A\to R_0\to R\to K'$ making $K'$ a fraction field of $R$, there are $R$-algebra structures on each $L_j$ compatible with $R\to K'\to L_j$ and an injective $R$-algebra map $f:(B\otimes_A R)_{\mathrm{red}}\to\prod_jL_j$. For every $j$ there is $e_j$ in the source with $f(e_j)_i=1$ if $i=j$ and $0$ otherwise. For every $j$ and every $z\in L_j$ there are $0\ne a\in R$ and $x$ in the source with $az=f(x)_j$.

proof.text: Form C = (B tensor_A R0)_red, a finite module over the Noetherian domain R0. Tensor associativity and localization of the nilradical identify its generic fibre over K prime with the specified product of fields. Its torsion kernel is finitely generated. Choose a nonzero annihilator for each generator and multiply them; localization at this product kills the kernel.

Represent the finitely many coordinate idempotents as fractions in C with nonzero R0 denominators. Multiply these denominators with the annihilator product to obtain nonzero t. If t divides s, localization at s inverts each factor of t, retains injectivity and contains the coordinate idempotents. Reduction commutes with localization, identifying the source with (B tensor_A R)_red. Generic surjectivity expresses any coordinate field element as a numerator over a nonzero base denominator; its image in R stays nonzero because R has fraction field K prime. If r = 0, the kernel is all of C and localization kills it; the coordinate assertions are vacuous.

theorem exists_generic_product_localization
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (B : Type v) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Module.Finite A B]
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    (K' : Type (max u v)) [Field K'] [Algebra K K'] [Algebra A K']
    [IsScalarTower A K K']
    (R0 : Type (max u v)) [CommRing R0] [IsNoetherianRing R0] [IsDomain R0]
    [Algebra A R0] [Algebra R0 K'] [IsScalarTower A R0 K'] [IsFractionRing R0 K']
    (r : ℕ) (L : Fin r → Type (max u v)) [∀ j, Field (L j)]
    [∀ j, Algebra K' (L j)]
    (hsplit :
      letI := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra (R := K) (A := K ⊗[A] B) (B := K')
      Nonempty ((((K ⊗[A] B) ⊗[K] K') ⧸
        nilradical ((K ⊗[A] B) ⊗[K] K')) ≃ₐ[K'] (∀ j, L j))) :
    ∃ t : R0, t ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ (s : R0), t ∣ s →
      ∀ (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra R0 R] [IsLocalization.Away s R]
        [Algebra A R] [IsScalarTower A R0 R] [Algebra R K']
        [IsScalarTower R0 R K'] [IsFractionRing R K'],
        ∃ (_ : ∀ j, Algebra R (L j)) (_ : ∀ j, IsScalarTower R K' (L j)),
          letI := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra (R := A) (A := B) (B := R)
          ∃ f : ((B ⊗[A] R) ⧸ nilradical (B ⊗[A] R)) →ₐ[R] (∀ j, L j),
            Function.Injective f ∧
            (∀ j, ∃ e, ∀ i, f e i = if i = j then 1 else 0) ∧
            (∀ j (z : L j), ∃ a : R, a ≠ 0 ∧
              ∃ x, algebraMap R (L j) a * z = f x j)
